title: Role transfer actions done in a single-step manner are dangerous
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as important protocol functionality would become unusable  **Likelihood:** Low, as it requires an admin/owner error  ## Description  This is a common problem where transferring a role or admin rights to a different address can go wrong if this address is wrong and not actually controlled by any user. This is taken into consideration in `NodeRegistry` where the node ownership transfer is a two-step operation.
